changelog:
Initial public release of Conversion Copywriter — The Complete Persuasion System.

- Provides a complete, step-by-step process for creating high-converting copy, from project brief to research and frameworks.
- Includes detailed templates for briefs, Voice-of-Customer mining, and competitor audits.
- Outlines and explains five core copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB, 4Ps, PASTOR) with use cases and fill-in-the-blank templates.
- Features a framework selection guide for different copy situations.
- Supplies headline formulas and wiring guidance to ensure compelling messaging.
- Emphasizes research, psychology, and message-audience match for maximum persuasion.
summary: Write persuasive, high-converting copy for headlines, landing pages, emails, ads, and sales pages using proven psychology and structured frameworks.
